web_fixture.title: Pitch types and site rules - Caldermere Fields
web_fixture.snippet: An overview of pitch types, seasonal rates and the site rules that apply to every booking.
web_fixture.content:
# Pitch types and site rules

Standard grass pitch: one tent up to 6 occupants, one car included.
Serviced pitch (electric hook-up): one tent up to 6 occupants on
hardstanding, with a 16 amp hook-up. Moonlight safari tents sleep 4
and are booked separately.

Site rules: quiet hours 22:30-07:00, one fire pit per booking, dogs on
leads in the meadow.

web_fixture.title: Seasonal rates - Caldermere Fields
web_fixture.snippet: Nightly rates by season and pitch type.
web_fixture.content:
# Seasonal rates

Standard grass pitch: 22 pounds off-peak, 28 pounds summer.
Serviced pitch: 28 pounds off-peak, 34 pounds summer.
Safari tents: 95 pounds flat, two-night minimum.
